name: Asuhara Misa
source: Oldest daughter of Asuhara house hold. She likes to tease the protagonist and is consider to be close. The protagonist thinks of her as another sister that he can't hide anything from her as she easily reads him better than anyone of his other sisters. She is usual a cool woman but when it comes to fuuko her childhood friend will become childish quarreling.
